expert-team-orchestration.acceptance_bou: A successful run or green tests do not accept a task. A successor waits for formal acceptance of the exact predecessor run created by this plan. Business dependencies do not automatically combine Git candidates.
expert-team-orchestration.review_require: The original run completed. An authorized person must formally review this exact run before successors may start.
expert-team-orchestration.help.pause: Pause prevents new task dispatch. Existing runs continue and retain their own cancellation and reconciliation controls.
expert-team-orchestration.help.resume: Resume uses your current browser or scoped API credential for later dispatch. Every pending source and permission is checked again; changed source is not silently adopted.
expert-team-orchestration.help.stop: Stop is final for unstarted work. Existing runs continue until stopped or reconciled separately in their original run views.
expert-team-orchestration.help.revise: Explicitly read current pending task versions and published roles, then revise only selected unstarted tasks. Started source and run identities remain fixed.
expert-team-orchestration.ack.pause: I confirm pausing only new dispatch; existing runs continue.
expert-team-orchestration.ack.resume: I authorize later dispatch with this current credential after all pending bases and permissions are rechecked.
expert-team-orchestration.ack.stop: I confirm stopping unstarted work permanently. This does not stop running processes.
expert-team-orchestration.ack.revise: I reviewed these current task versions and roles and approve a new fixed source revision. Started tasks stay unchanged.
expert-team-orchestration.command_recove: Recover this exact original plan command and key. Do not create a replacement effect or alter an existing run.
expert-team-orchestration.revision_input: Current unstarted tasks or the published configuration could not be read. No revised source was submitted.
expert-team-orchestration.configuration_: The published configuration changed. Explicitly include every unstarted task before saving this revision.
expert-team-orchestration.started_immuta: Already started; remove it from this edit. Its original source and run are immutable.
expert-team-orchestration.started_preser: {{count}} started task(s) retain their original source, role and run.
expert-team-orchestration.history_empty: No source revision history was returned.
expert-team-orchestration.historical_rea: Source revision {{value}} · read only, no current actions
expert-team-orchestration.selected_depen: Recorded prerequisite IDs: {{value}}. Their actual acceptance is checked in the fixed preview.
expert-team-orchestration.no_project_pla: No team plans are available in this project.
expert-team-orchestration.reason.graph: The task dependency graph is invalid. Check cycles, self-references and project scope.
expert-team-orchestration.reason.source: Pending task source changed. Pause and explicitly revise the unstarted work.
expert-team-orchestration.reason.wrong_r: The predecessor was accepted against a different run. It does not satisfy this plan's fixed gate.
expert-team-orchestration.reason.stopped: This plan's unstarted work is stopped. Active runs retain their original controls.
expert-team-orchestration.reason.paused: New dispatch is paused. Existing runs continue.
expert-team-orchestration.reason.authori: The activation credential is no longer authorized. A current authorized actor must explicitly resume.
expert-team-orchestration.reason.revisio: A source revision may only change unstarted tasks.
expert-team-orchestration.reason.run_blo: Inspect or recover the original run. The plan does not automatically retry it.
